notes.title: Buffet Knight - Decadent Full Course: March 6th! Play the Demo in Next Fest Now!
notes.notes:
Browsing Next Fest and looking for a game you can really sink your teeth into? A game that can satisfy your hunger for top down 2d adventure?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512849/edea64e7fe85a202f775047e329dc775d2087232.png[/img]

Then feast your eyes on the upcoming all new, supersized Buffet Knight - Decadent Full Course, coming March 6th!

[previewyoutube=9grMxv6JGFU;full][/previewyoutube]
The Gourmet Kingdom is in hot water: the Demon Chef has stolen all their food! And there is only one morsel of hope: The Buffet Knight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512849/47a751807c10410e055304b06b5ff90e49875796.gif[/img]

Take on the role of this tiny hero as he consumes everything that would stop him from saving the kingdom, and probably anything else he runs across as well. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, find treasure, and discover delectable secrets on your way to becoming the kingdom’s hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512849/e9897d4a6d17207a7eb891fcaab928f42474ecfa.png[/img]

Need a little snack? Play the free demo today to whet your appetite, all your progress will carry over! But be sure to get a seat at the table for the full game on March 6th! Wishlist today and be ready for a smorgasbord of fun!
